facts.statement: For Free Realms' birthday, players who logged in on 4/28/2012 received a free Birthday Cake Hat, and Station Cash purchases were tripled for that day.
facts.quote: Get a FREE Birthday Cake Hat by logging into Free Realms today!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post announcing a 4/28/2012 Free Realms birthday event: a free Birthday Cake Hat for logging in that day, and triple Station Cash on purchases during a 24-hour window. The post is a short promo; it gives no quest, item-stat, or price details beyond the bonus terms.
